Subject: Thanks for the call — next steps

Jonas —

Thanks for taking the time earlier. Quick recap from our side: CareLynx is looking to add an LLM-powered triage assistant for clinician notes. The main constraints we discussed are:
- HIPAA-compliant handling of PHI and auditability
- P95 latency target ideally under 250ms (for short prompts)
- Evaluate cost impact at ~1M tokens/month scale

We'd like to move to a demo/technical deep dive and then run a short evaluation (3 weeks) to validate latency and quality.

Availability this week for a 60m technical demo:
- Wed (Nov 3): 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu (Nov 4): 13:00–14:00 PT
- Fri (Nov 5): 09:00–10:00 PT

Can you confirm which slot you prefer? Also, we'll bring Tom Benson (engineering manager) and our security lead if possible — I can add them to the invite once we lock time.

I'll send a one-page success criteria doc after I finish drafting it.

Best,
Lydia
Director of Product
CareLynx

Recap of your goals:
- Production latency and cost optimization for clinician note triage
- HIPAA and auditability requirements (we noted KMS/HSM and audit log needs)
- Evaluation to validate p95 latency and label-level quality on your prompt set

Suggested next steps:
1) Technical demo / deep dive (60m) — I can run through architecture, batching/quantization options, and our private deployment model. Proposed slots (pick one):
   - Thu, Nov 4, 13:00–14:00 PT
   - Wed, Nov 3, 10:00–11:00 PT
   - Fri, Nov 5, 09:00–10:00 PT
2) Evaluation kickoff (3-week pilot) — we’ll provide a sandbox instance, a prompt pack template for you to fill (prompt_pack_template.csv), and a mutual action plan.
3) Security checklist exchange — we’ll have Monica help scope HIPAA/SC questions and collection of evidence (SOC2 artifacts, KMS options).

Could you confirm:
- Which demo slot works best?
- Who should be included on the invite (please share names/emails)
- Any hard acceptance criteria (examples: p95 <200ms on 95% of short prompts; quality threshold: F1 > 0.75 on your validation set)?

I’m attaching a small prompt pack template and a mutual action plan stub in my follow-up (I'll send attachments in a separate message to make them easy to download). Monica will own the security Q&A.

If Thu 13:00 PT works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a meeting link.

Thanks — looking forward.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
